title: Los Alamos working group concludes UFOs are interdimensional
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

plain: In the 2000s, a working group at Los Alamos National Laboratory in New Mexico is said to have concluded that UFOs are "interdimensional objects coming down into a lower dimensional plane." Jay Anderson, a guest who describes himself as a witness of the phenomenon, tells Michels he heard this from a man named Oke Shannon, and compares it to Flatland, a story about creatures living in a flat, two-dimensional world. If true, scientists at a top weapons lab believed UFOs come from other dimensions.
